context: Daichi takes Sho-young to a kid sports event; spectator role.
purpose: Father and son experiencing sport together.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: 翔、ふたりで、応援しよか!
lines.en: Sho, come on — let's cheer for them together!
lines.style: Warm, expansive Kansai drawl. Opening with energy and invitation. Soft underneath — genuinely wanting to share this moment with his son. The kind of dad who makes ordinary moments feel special.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: うん、黒いユニフォーム、応援する!
lines.en: Yeah! I'm gonna cheer for the black uniforms!
lines.style: Bright, clear child's voice with genuine excitement. No performance — this is real enthusiasm. Eager to match his dad's energy. Slight lean forward in the voice.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: あの子、ようけ走っとるな、熱心や!
lines.en: Look at that kid go — running all over the place. Real hustle!
lines.style: Animated Kansai warmth. Eyes lighting up as he watches. Quick delivery, admiring tone. The generous way he notices good effort in others and says it out loud.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ぼくも、ああいう冒険、してみたい!
lines.en: I want to do something like that someday. Have an adventure like that.
lines.style: Quiet, thoughtful child's voice. Softer than before — he's being sincere about what he wants. Not wistful, but genuinely imagining. Slight pause before 'adventure,' like it's important.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: 関わっていけば、できるで、何でも。
lines.en: If you jump in and try, you can do anything. Trust me.
lines.style: Quiet, steady Kansai warmth. This one means something — not rushed. Calm certainty underneath. The voice of a dad who actually believes this and wants his son to believe it too.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.en: When do we play them? When's the match?
lines.style: Curious, eager child's voice. Soft but attentive — he's engaged and wants to know what comes next. The specific question of someone thinking ahead.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: もうすぐや、楽しみやな!
lines.en: Pretty soon. I can't wait either, honestly.
lines.style: Gentle Kansai warmth with genuine affection underneath. Soft opening, slight smile in the voice. He's sharing his own anticipation with his son — father and child on the same side of the feeling.
